checks.text: With the source timezone set to "UTC" and the target timezone set to "New York", entering "2024-01-15" in the date field and "14:30" in the time field shows "09:30" in the output time field.
With the source timezone set to "New York" and the target timezone set to "Tokyo", entering "2024-07-15" in the date field and "10:00" in the time field shows "23:00" in the output time field.

Clicking the button "Save conversion" with source "UTC", target "London", date "2024-03-10", time "12:00" adds a row to the history table containing "UTC", "London", "2024-03-10", "12:00", and "12:00".
After saving a conversion, clicking the "History" tab shows a table with a column header "Source" and a row containing "UTC" and "London".
Clicking the button "Copy result" copies "12:00" to the clipboard when the output time is "12:00".
With the source timezone set to "UTC" and the target timezone set to "Sydney", entering "2024-01-15" in the date field and "00:00" in the time field shows "10:00" in the output time field.
Clicking the button "Swap" exchanges the source and target timezones; if source was "UTC" and target was "New York", after clicking source becomes "New York" and target becomes "UTC".

Reload keeps the saved conversion: after saving a conversion with source "UTC", target "London", date "2024-03-10", time "12:00" and reloading, the History tab still shows a row containing "UTC", "London", "2024-03-10", "12:00", and "12:00".
